scripts.sync-content: aws s3 sync s3://disrupt-hub-content/ ../articles-published/ --endpoint-url https://storage.yandexcloud.net --profile yandex --delete --exclude '*' --include '*.md'
scripts.deploy: npm run sync-content && npm run clean && astro build && aws s3 sync dist/ s3://disrupt-hub-deploy/ --endpoint-url https://storage.yandexcloud.net --profile yandex --acl public-read --delete
scripts.deploy:admin: aws s3 sync ../admin/web/ s3://disrupt-hub-deploy/admin/ --endpoint-url https://storage.yandexcloud.net --profile yandex --acl public-read --delete --cache-control no-cache
